Objective

Create a modern, dark-theme, highly animated personal portfolio website for a Senior Full Stack Developer / System Development Specialist with 8+ years of experience.

The portfolio must communicate technical authority, leadership, scalability, and enterprise-level expertise, not a junior or generic developer profile.

Design & UI Requirements

Theme: Dark mode by default (black / charcoal / deep navy)

Accent colors: Electric blue, neon cyan, or purple highlights

Typography:

Headings: Modern tech fonts (Inter, Poppins, Space Grotesk, or similar)

Body: Clean, readable sans-serif

Layout: Clean, spacious, professional, enterprise-grade

Icons: Use high-quality vector icons (Font Awesome / Lucide / Hero Icons)

Animations:

Smooth scroll

Section reveal animations

Hover micro-interactions

Animated counters and charts

Subtle parallax on hero section

Performance: Fast load, optimized animations, responsive for all devices

Homepage (Must Contain Everything Important)

The front page must be comprehensive, not minimal.

Name: Khalid Usman

Role:
Senior Full Stack Developer | System Development Specialist

“Designing scalable, secure, and mission-critical systems for NGOs, Government, and Enterprise Platforms.”

View Projects

Contact Me

GitHub

LinkedIn

8+ years experience

Full SDLC expertise

Progress bars

Animated counters

Key achievements

Impact on organization

Project title

Description

Tech stack

Organization

Category (HRMIS, MIS, GIS, ERP)

MIS Platforms

Inventory & Job Portals

Add:

Filter by category

Hover animations

Modal popup for details

Certifications & Training

Show as elegant cards:

GIS Training (iMMAP / ANDMA)

ASDC Certification

Android Training

Big Data Analytics (UNDP)

Contact Section

Contact form with animation

Email, phone, location

Social icons

Clear CTA:
“Let’s build scalable systems together”

Footer

Copyright

Quick links

Social icons

Dark minimalist style

Technical Expectations

Fully responsive (mobile, tablet, desktop)

SEO-optimized

Accessible (WCAG friendly)

Modern frontend stack

Clean component structure

Overall Style

The website must feel:

Senior-level

Enterprise-grade

Trustworthy

Technically authoritative

Suitable for NGOs, UN agencies, and government stakeholders

Avoid:

Over-cartoonish design

Overuse of neon

Junior-style portfolios

Deliver a complete, visually stunning, professional portfolio website aligned with a senior full-stack developer profile.

**Focusing on Portfolio Goals**

I've been honing in on the core objectives for Khalid's portfolio. The plan is to communicate his technical prowess and leadership, focusing on scalability and the impact of his work. Dark mode is definitely a key design direction!


**Developing Visual Story**

I've just added some animation-driven elements to the plan. I'm focusing on Khalid's background and experience - 8+ years as a Senior Full Stack Developer and System Development Specialist. The structure is coming together with a dark theme and electric blue accents, and I'm looking at `framer-motion` for animations, `lucide-react` for icons, `recharts` for data visualization, and `react-intersection-observer` for trigger reveals. The project structure is now clearly defined. Core components, from navigation to the footer, are in place, alongside essential data files and types. The focus is now on fleshing out each section. Navigation will feature a glassmorphism style, while the Hero section will have a particle background or gradient mesh with bold typography. I'm focusing on animated radar and pie charts for skills to visually represent expertise.


**Implementing Technical Depth**

I'm now integrating the specific technical frameworks into the plan. Scroll-triggered entrance animations, powered by `framer-motion`, will be used. Project filters will let people sort through Khalid's work. The design will use a dark mode with a `#0a0a0a` background and cyan accents. I'm making sure charts represent real tech proficiency, and the timeline reflects an enterprise aesthetic.
